title: Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve, Generate, and Critique through Self-Reflection
text: Self-RAG introduces a framework where retrieval and generation are interleaved with critique signals, helping answers remain grounded in retrieved evidence.

title: Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve, Generate, and Critique through Self-Reflection
text: The method is useful for Agentic RAG because it treats retrieval quality and answer support as decisions that can be supervised and evaluated.
